description:
FILED s473t5c (#1501 round 4, `comp/` CHECK 2).  PRE-EXISTING.  LOW VALUE
(10 rows in one file, a lexer corner) -- filed so the rows carry a cause, not
because it should jump any queue.

t/comp/colon.t's whole subject is: when a name that is also a QUOTE-LIKE
OPERATOR (`m q qq qw qx s tr y`) appears before `::` or `:`, perl's tokenizer
reads the OPERATOR, not the name.  PCL reads the name.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl) -- each line is four eval truth values,
`package X; sub zyx{1}; 1` / `X::zyx` / `X:: eq X||` / `X::: >= 0`:

    ABC   perl 1100   PCL 1100     (an ordinary name: both agree)
    q     perl 1010   PCL 1100
    s     perl 1001   PCL 1100
    and the bare-colon forms `m:1` / `m:echo: eq m|echo|` / `m:echo:ohce: >= 0`
    are 010 on BOTH -- PCL already lexes `m:…:` as a match.

So the divergence is exactly the `::`-after-a-quote-operator spellings: perl
takes `q::zyx` as `q` with `:` delimiters (a string), `s:::` as a substitution
with `:` delimiters, and `y:::` likewise -- which is why the expected truth
pattern differs per operator (m/q/qq/qw/qx are "the `X||` form works", s/tr/y
are "the `X:::` form works").

WHAT IT COSTS: t/comp/colon.t DIFF 15/10 -- its 10 fail rows are tests 4-11
(`package m q qq qw qx s tr y`) plus 18 (`qw:echo:`) and 24 (`y:1`).  No
shortfall; the file runs to the end.

FIX SHAPE (if ever): this is PPI's tokenizer boundary, not PCL's -- check
whether `PPI::Document` on `q::zyx` already gives a Quote token, and if it
does then the gap is PCL's consumption; if it gives a Word `q` plus `::zyx`,
it is a PPI bug and belongs in `docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md` with a row in
`docs/ppi-bug-report.t` (rule 13).  Measure that FIRST -- the whole task is
one `PPI::Dumper` run away from being correctly filed against the right
project.

MEASURED, so it IS filed against the right project: `PPI::Dumper` on
`$x = q::zyx;` under PPI 1.291 gives

    PPI::Token::Symbol    '$x'
    PPI::Token::Operator  '='
    PPI::Token::Word      'q::zyx'      <-- perl reads `q` + `::zyx` as a STRING
    PPI::Token::Structure ';'

-> a PPI TOKENIZER divergence, so when a workaround ships it owes a section in
`docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md` plus rows in `docs/ppi-bug-report.t` (rule 13,
whose scope is "in the same commit as its workaround" -- nothing is worked
around here yet).
subject: A QUOTE-LIKE OPERATOR name used as a package (`q::zyx`, `s:: eq s||`, `tr:::`) is read as an ordinary package name -- perl's tokenizer sees the operator; t/comp/colon.t's 10 fail rows
